title: InventoryMovementDTO
description: Warehouse movement in the new system. Target of the migration (SPEC-009), generated automatically when documents are issued (SPEC-010) and source of format 12.1 (SPEC-013).

unitOfMeasure.description: Catalog 03 unit of the movement; exported to table 6 through the UnitMappingCatalog.

sourceDocument.description: Transfer document, payment document, internal document or similar that supports the movement.

series.description: '0' if the document has no series (format 12.1 field 12).

number.description: '0' if the document has no number (format 12.1 field 13).

balanceAfter.description: Product balance per establishment after this movement. May be negative for migrated history (see docs/06-legacy-migration.md).
